modules.title: Safety Guardian
modules.description: Checks for potential warning signs and helps users understand when professional medical care may be needed.
modules.purpose: Identify potential red flags without diagnosing.

modules.title: Your Next Step
modules.description: Provides general health-navigation guidance based on the information provided.
modules.purpose: Help users understand what they can consider doing next.

modules.title: Help Me Say It
modules.description: Helps users turn their concerns into clear questions they can share with a healthcare provider.

modules.title: DoctorReady Conversation Card
modules.description: Creates a concise conversation guide that users can take to a healthcare appointment.
modules.purpose: Prepare users for meaningful healthcare conversations.
